module.name: roksbnkctl-flp
module.description: Deploy the F5 License Proxy as a standalone IBM Cloud VSI appliance (no cluster) with roksbnkctl's flp phase. Procedural container_image artifact run by the container engine.

required.name: region
required.description: IBM Cloud region the FLP VSI is created in (e.g. us-south).

required.name: prefix
required.description: Resource name prefix for the appliance (e.g. acme-flp).

optional.name: flp_vsi_vpc
optional.label: Existing VPC (id) to deploy into
optional.description: Existing VPC ID to deploy the FLP VSI into — the adopt path, and what a cluster on a Transit Gateway needs. Leave blank ONLY if 'Build the proxy its own VPC' is true; roksbnkctl refuses both together, and refuses neither.

optional.name: flp_vsi_create_vpc
optional.label: Build the proxy its own VPC
optional.description: true builds the proxy a VPC, address prefix and public gateway of its own instead of placing it in one that already exists (roksbnkctl v1.45.0+). Mutually exclusive with the existing-VPC id — roksbnkctl refuses both, because the new VPC would silently win and the proxy would come up with no route to the clusters licensing against it. NOTE: a VPC created this way has no Transit Gateway attachment, and roksbnkctl has no way to add one, so only clusters IN that VPC can reach the proxy. To serve clusters over a gateway, adopt a VPC already on it.

optional.name: flp_vsi_vpc_name
optional.label: Name for the created VPC
optional.description: Names the VPC built when the option above is true. Blank = flp-vsi-vpc. Ignored on the adopt path.

optional.name: flp_vsi_subnet_cidr
optional.label: Address prefix for the created VPC
optional.description: Address prefix for the VPC built when the option above is true, e.g. 10.250.0.0/24. It must not overlap anything the consuming clusters can already route to — a Transit Gateway silently blackholes one of two overlapping VPCs. Ignored on the adopt path.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.description: IBM Cloud API key. Filled from the project's credential template at creation and carried by the module, so the module keeps working even if the project's template is cleared later.

optional.name: flp_vsi_zone
optional.description: Zone for the VSI (e.g. us-south-1). Blank = the region's first zone.

optional.name: flp_vsi_profile
optional.description: VSI instance profile. Blank = bx2-4x16 (the FLP's 4 vCPU / 8 GB floor).

optional.name: flp_vsi_ssh_key
optional.description: Name of an existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key to attach, for operator access to the appliance.

optional.name: flp_vsi_boot_size_gb
optional.description: Boot volume size in GB. Blank = 100 (clears the FLP's >80 GB requirement).

optional.name: flp_vsi_reach
optional.description: Address the consuming cluster's CWC dials: private (default) or floating.

optional.name: flp_vsi_floating_ip
optional.description: Attach an operator floating IP for remote flp status + the :80 web UI. Not the CWC endpoint.

optional.name: flp_management_allowed_cidrs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to reach the :80 status UI. Blank = 0.0.0.0/0 (read-only page).

optional.name: flp_licensing_allowed_cidrs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to reach the :8443 proxy and :22. Blank = the RFC-1918 private ranges.

optional.name: flp_status_image
optional.description: flp-status web UI image, e.g. <harbor>/bnk-status/flp-status:v1. Blank = no status UI.

optional.name: flp_status_registry_host
optional.description: Registry host serving the status image. Only needed for a private/self-signed mirror.

optional.name: flp_status_registry_ca_b64
optional.description: Base64 CA for the status image's registry, dropped into the VSI's certs.d so the pull is trusted.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version the FLP chart set is resolved from. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR supply chain, when not using the local-file path. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_bucket
optional.description: COS bucket holding the FAR supply chain. Blank = bnk-artifacts.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.description: COS bucket region. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.description: FAR auth tarball object name in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Subscription JWT object name in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: flp_namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace the F5 License Proxy client resources go into. Blank keeps the default the subscription JWT implies.

optional.name: flp_vsi_name_prefix
optional.label: Prefix for the appliance's resource names
optional.description: Prefix for the appliance's IBM Cloud resource names (roksbnkctl v1.47.0+). Blank keeps the legacy unprefixed names — flp-vsi, flp-vsi-subnet, flp-vsi-sg and so on — which is the default so that upgrading does not rename and therefore REPLACE a running proxy. Set it to run more than one standalone proxy in an account (the literal names collide otherwise), and to make the appliance visible to the orphan blueprints, which sweep by <prefix>-* and cannot see an unprefixed flp-vsi.

key_outputs.name: endpoint
key_outputs.description: The FLP's licensing endpoint, reached privately by the consuming cluster's CWC.

key_outputs.name: external_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Externally-reachable proxy endpoint, for a BNK install in another cluster (bnk.flp.external.url).

key_outputs.name: root_ca_b64
key_outputs.description: The proxy's base64 root CA, which the consuming cluster must trust (bnk.flp.external.root_ca_b64).

key_outputs.name: floating_ip
key_outputs.description: Operator floating IP hosting the flp-status web UI on :80.
